meta.title: Korekto — assessment with human review
meta.description: Korekto connects uploading student work, AI-suggested grading and review by the teacher.

footer.tagline: AI-assisted grading. The decision always belongs to the teacher.

home.lead: Less time grading. More time for meaningful feedback.
home.description: A shared foundation for classes, assignments and student work — from upload to a result the teacher has actually reviewed.
home.principleTitle: The teacher always has the final say
home.principleText: No AI suggestion is published without the teacher actively reviewing and approving it.
home.workflowTitle: From work to result without shortcuts
home.workflowText: Three steps where responsibility always stays clear.

upload.title: Upload work
upload.description: A photo, scan or PDF is securely assigned to the student and the assignment.

ai.title: AI grading suggestion
ai.description: AI drafts points and feedback and marks the parts it is unsure about.

review.title: Review and publish
review.description: The teacher edits and approves the result. The student only sees the final grade.
